description.en: Sets a flag of the event system (bit 1 of its state flags). The events call it before a run of messages and CMND_MESWIN_UNLOCK after it (over 1700 pairs), which points to keeping the message window in place between the messages of a conversation. The engine code that reads the flag was not traced.

examples.case: Around a conversation (real usage, from ev42015100.nut)
